mapper.sql: FROM attractions a LEFT JOIN sidos s ON a.area_code = s.sido_code LEFT JOIN guguns g ON a.area_code = g.sido_code AND a.si_gun_gu_code = g.gugun_code LEFT JOIN contenttypes ct ON a.content_type_id = ct.content_type_id

where.if: AND MATCH(a.title, a.addr1, a.addr2) AGAINST(CONCAT(#{keyword}, '*') IN BOOLEAN MODE)

mapper.select:
SELECT a.no, a.title, a.first_image1 AS image_url, s.sido_name AS sido, g.gugun_name AS gugun, ct.content_type_name AS content_type, CONCAT_WS(' ', a.addr1, a.addr2) AS address, a.latitude, a.longitude
ORDER BY a.no DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT a.no, a.content_id, a.title, a.content_type_id, ct.content_type_name AS content_type, a.area_code, a.si_gun_gu_code, s.sido_name AS sido, g.gugun_name AS gugun, a.first_image1, a.first_image2, a.map_level, a.latitude, a.longitude, a.tel, a.addr1, a.addr2, a.homepage, a.overview FROM attractions a LEFT JOIN sidos s ON a.area_code = s.sido_code LEFT JOIN guguns g ON a.area_code = g.sido_code AND a.si_gun_gu_code = g.gugun_code LEFT JOIN contenttypes ct ON a.content_type_id = ct.content_type_id WHERE a.no = #{no}
